latest.author: rikleigh
latest.text: Thanks for the report! It was a bug: the browser created some of its folders in /data/ps5webkit (fonts, etc, share, cache) with permissions that stopped other apps, such as FTP or a file manager, from deleting them. Fixed in rikleigh/parallax-browser@56492a8: the browser now creates those folders so they can be deleted, and each time it starts it also fixes any folders an older version created. Sorry to hear that you didn't have a great experience. The latest version of the browser (0.2.1) has…
